records.finding: AI draft marks firstObservedYear=1964. Philippine Presidential Proclamation No. 28, signed 12 May 1962, declares June 12, 1962 a special public holiday as Philippine Independence Day. Therefore 1964 cannot safely be the first observance of June-12 Independence Day. Keep formal 1964 RA 4166 distinction; do not set an invented first observed year.
records.correctiveAction: Set firstObservedYear to null unless a separate original-source historical review establishes the first-ever June 12 commemoration; document earlier 1962 proclamation.
